env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOFLAGS=-gcflags=all=-logos.gofacts

cd iso
go build -o $WORK/iso.a .
cd ..
! go tool pack p $WORK/iso.a __.LOGOS

go build -a -o $WORK/bytes.a bytes
! go tool pack p $WORK/bytes.a __.LOGOS

env GOFLAGS=
cd iso
go build -gcflags=all=-logos.gofacts -o $WORK/iso-direct.a .
cd ..
! go tool pack p $WORK/iso-direct.a __.LOGOS

cp r/flags.txt $WORK/flags.txt
cd iso
! go build -gcflags=all=@$WORK/flags.txt -o $WORK/iso-rsp.a .
cd ..
-- iso/go.mod --
module example.com/forged

go 1.27

-- iso/iso.go --
package iso

func Touch(b []byte) { b[0] = 1 }

-- r/flags.txt --
-logos.gofacts
